# 2.0 ---- Setup ----


## 2.1 Load Libraries

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
if (!nzchar(system.file(package = "librarian"))) 
  install.packages("librarian")

librarian::shelf(
  quiet = TRUE,
  librarian, conflicted, ggplot2, tibble, tidyr, readr, purrr, dplyr, stringr,
  forcats, lubridate, glue, fs, magrittr, here,
  
  # additional
  sf, geodata, ggrepel, tidyterra,
  readxl, janitor, cowplot
)

conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter(), 
  dplyr::select()
  )
  

```

```{r placencia-bbox}
# projection
wgs_crs     <- 4326 # WGS 84
belize_epsg <- 32616 # for Belize

placencia_bbox <-
  tribble(
    ~lon,    ~lat,
    -88.440, 16.5,
    -88.440, 16.685,
    -88.303, 16.685,
    -88.303, 16.5
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = wgs_crs) %>%
  st_combine() %>%
  st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
  # convert to projection in meters
  st_transform(crs = belize_epsg) %T>%
  print()

# bounding box 
bbox <- st_bbox(placencia_bbox) %T>% 
  print()

# convert to wgs
st_transform(bbox, crs = wgs_crs)


region_col <- c(
  "Upper" = "#0072B2", 
  "Lower" = "#D55E00", 
  "Main Creeks" = "#CC79A7")

# print without degree symbol or N/S/E/W
plain_coord <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
```

```{r belize-map}
# belize map object from geodata then projected
belize_sf <- 
  geodata::gadm(country = "Belize", level = 0, path = tempdir()) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_transform(belize_epsg) %>% 

  # crop belize to mangrove bounds
  st_crop(bbox)

belize_sf
plot(belize_sf[2])

if (FALSE) {
  # dark basemap
  shelf(maptiles)
  
  belize_tile <- 
    st_transform(bbox, crs = wgs_crs) %>% # convert to WGS
    # get_tiles(provider = "CartoDB.DarkMatterNoLabels", zoom = 14) %>%
    get_tiles(provider = "Esri.WorldImagery", zoom = 14) %>%
    project(paste0("EPSG:", belize_epsg)) # project to Belize UTM
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_spatraster_rgb(data = belize_tile)
}
```

## 2.2 Load Dataset

```{r shp-dir}
# belize_dir <- rstudioapi::selectDirectory()
belize_dir <- here("data", "raw", "placencia", "belize-shapefiles")
```

From <https://download.geofabrik.de/central-america/belize.html>

```{r shp-file}
dir_ls(belize_dir, regexp = "shp$") %>%
  basename()

# extract belize water ways
belize_dat <-
  belize_dir %>%
  dir_ls(regexp = "waterways.*.shp$") %>%
  st_read()

belize_dat <- 
  belize_dat %>%
  st_transform(crs = belize_epsg) %>%
  # crop belize to mangrove bounds
  st_crop(bbox)

plot(belize_dat["fclass"])

# extract northern boundary road 'Caribbean Way'
road_dat <-
  belize_dir %>%
  dir_ls(regexp = "roads.*.shp$") %>%
  st_read()

road_dat <-
  road_dat %>%
  st_transform(crs = belize_epsg) %>%
  filter(str_detect(name, "(?i)Caribbean Way"))

# extract northern boundary road 'Caribbean Way'
places_dat <-
  belize_dir %>%
  dir_ls(regexp = "places_free.*.shp$") %>%
  st_read()

places_dat <-
  places_dat %>%
  st_transform(crs = belize_epsg) %>%
  # crop belize to mangrove bounds
  # st_crop(bbox) %>%
  filter(str_detect(name, "(?i)Placencia$|Seine Bight|Maya Beach|Riversdale|Plantation"))

plot(places_dat["name"])
```

## 2.5 Path for Mangrove Map and Data

```{r path-data}
# biomass excel file
biomass_path <- 
  here("data", "raw", "placencia") %>%
  dir_ls(regexp = "Placencia") %>% 
  str_subset("update2") %>% 
  str_subset("~", negate = TRUE) %T>% 
  print()
```

```{r}
# read mangrove biomass dataset
biomass_dat <- 
  readxl::read_xlsx(biomass_path) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  select(-x5) %>%
  janitor::remove_empty("cols") %>%
  janitor::remove_empty("rows") %>%
  mutate(
    upper_lower = if_else(str_detect(upper_lower, "Mango"), "Main Creeks", upper_lower),
    side = ifelse(long < -88.38, "west", "east")
  ) 
biomass_dat

# locations as dataframe
biomass_loc <- 
  biomass_dat %>%
  select(
    station_id,
    "point" = samplingpoint,
    "lat"   = lat,
    "long"  = long,
    upper_lower,
    side
    ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  drop_na(lat, long) %>%
  mutate(lat = as.numeric(lat)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), remove = FALSE, crs = wgs_crs) %>%
  # convert to projection in meters
  st_transform(crs = belize_epsg) %>%
  mutate(
    x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2],
  ) %>%
  filter(
    between(y, bbox[2], bbox[4]),
    between(x, bbox[1], bbox[3]),
  )
count(biomass_loc, station_id)

```

# 3.0 Create Maps

## 3.1 Create Plot Labels
```{r plt-labels}
# Labels for the neighbors (placed by hand; adjust to taste)
country_labels <- tibble(
    name  = c("MEXICO",  "GUATEMALA", "BELIZE"),
    lon   = c(-89.0,     -89.3,       -88.7   ),
    lat   = c(18.1,      17,          17.2    ),
    angle = c(0,         90,          0       ),
    color = c("black",   "black",     "white" )
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = paste0("EPSG:", belize_epsg))

waterway_labels <- 
  tribble(
    ~name,                ~lon,     ~lat,   ~color,
    "Flour\nCamp\nCreek", -88.392, 16.599, "black",
    # "Mango\nCreek",       -88.417, 16.560, "black",
    "Mango\nCreek",       -88.410, 16.547, "black",
    "Santa Maria Creek",  -88.398, 16.630, "black",
    "Big Creek",          -88.437, 16.507, "black",
    "Placencia\nLagoon",  -88.394, 16.536, "black",
    "Placencia\nLagoon",  -88.369, 16.615, "black",
    "Caribbean Sea",      -88.325, 16.590, "black"
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = paste0("EPSG:", belize_epsg))

# used to specify east/west for plotting station labels
ew_line <- 
  tribble(
    ~ew,       ~lon,    ~lat,
    "x_west",  -88.417, 16.60,
    "x_west2", -88.400, 16.60,
    "x_51",    -88.395, 16.561,
    "x_east",  -88.350, 16.600
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = paste0("EPSG:", belize_epsg)) %>%
  st_coordinates()
  
ew_line <- c(
  purrr::set_names(ew_line[,1], c("x_west", "x_west2", "x_51", "x_east")),
  purrr::set_names(ew_line[,2] , c("y_west", "y_west2", "y_51", "y_east"))
)
  
```

## 3.2 Create Placencia Lagoon Map 

```{r}
belize_stn_map <- 
  ggplot() +
  # geom_spatraster_rgb(data = belize_tile) + # esri imagery
  geom_sf(data = belize_sf, fill = "#ccfce5", alpha = 1) + # gadm image
  
  # unnamed waterways
  geom_sf(
    data  = filter(belize_dat, is.na(name)), 
    color = prismatic::clr_lighten("#46b7ee", 0.2)
    ) +
  
  # named waterways
  geom_sf(
    data = filter_out(belize_dat, is.na(name)), 
    color = "#46b7ee",
    linewidth = rel(1.5)
    ) +

  # named road
  geom_sf(
    data = road_dat,
    color = "grey",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = rel(1.5)
    ) +
  
  # road labels
  geom_sf_text(
     data    = slice(road_dat, 1), 
    aes(label = name), 
    angle = -90,
    color    = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = 0,
    nudge_x = 0.4 * 1000,
    nudge_y = 0.2 * 1000,
    size = rel(2.5)
  ) +
  
   # cities
  geom_sf(
    data = places_dat,
    color = "red",
    shape = 17,
    size = rel(1.5)
    ) +
  
  # city labels
  geom_sf_text(
    data    = places_dat,
    aes(label = name), 
    # angle = -90,
    color    = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = 0.0,
    nudge_x = -c(0, 0.8, 0.5, 0.12) * 1000,
    nudge_y = c(0, 0.35, 0.3, 0.5) * 1000,
    size = rel(4)
  ) +
  
  # waterway labels
  geom_sf_text(
     data    = waterway_labels, 
    aes(label = name), 
    color    = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = 0,
    size = rel(3)
  ) +
  
  # ---- plot eastern site labels ---- #
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = filter(biomass_loc, side == "east"),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = station_id, color = upper_lower),
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps       = Inf,
    size               = rel(4),
    segment.color      = "black",
    segment.alpha     = 0.7,
    # segment.curvature = 0.5,
    show.legend        = FALSE,
    xlim               = c(ew_line["x_east"], NA),
    max.time = 2
  ) +
  
  # ---- plot western site labels ---- #
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = filter(biomass_loc, side == "west")  %>%
      filter_out(station_id %in% c(51, 52, 54, 29)),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = station_id, color = upper_lower),
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps       = Inf,
    size               = rel(4),
    segment.color      = "black",
    segment.alpha     = 0.7,
    segment.inflect = -0.5,
    show.legend        = FALSE,
    xlim               = c(NA, ew_line["x_west"]),  
    max.time = 2
  ) +

  # ---- plot other site labels ---- #
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = filter(biomass_loc, side == "west", station_id %in% c(54,29)),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = station_id, color = upper_lower),
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps       = Inf,
    size               = rel(4),
    segment.color      = "black",
    segment.alpha     = 0.7,
    segment.inflect = -0.5,
    show.legend        = FALSE,
    xlim               = c(ew_line["x_west2"], NA),  
    max.time = 2
  ) +

  # ---- plot site 51 labels ---- #
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = filter(biomass_loc, side == "west", station_id %in% c(51, 52)),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = station_id, color = upper_lower),
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps       = Inf,
    size               = rel(4),
    segment.color      = "black",
    segment.alpha     = 0.7,
    segment.inflect = -0.5,
    show.legend        = FALSE,
    xlim               = c(ew_line["x_51"], NA),  
    ylim               = c(ew_line["y_51"], NA),  
    max.time = 2
  ) +
  
  # ---- plot sample locations ---- #
  geom_sf(
    data = biomass_loc,
    aes(color = upper_lower),
    size = rel(1.5),
    key_glyph = draw_key_rect
  ) +
  
  ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "br",
    pad_y    = unit(0.4, "in"),
    style    = ggspatial::north_arrow_orienteering(fill = c("white", "white"))
    ) + 
  ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "br") +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_continuous(na.value = "transparent") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(16.52, 16.68, 0.02), labels = plain_coord,
                     expand = expansion()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-88.44, -88.32, 0.02), labels = plain_coord) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name   = "Region",
    values = region_col,
    breaks = names(region_col)
    ) +
  coord_sf(
    expand     = FALSE,
    ylim       = bbox[c(2,4)],
    xlim       = bbox[c(1,3)],
    label_axes = "ENEN"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background       = element_rect(fill = "#46b7ee"),
    legend.position        = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.89, 0.2),
    legend.background      = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

belize_stn_map
# plotly::ggplotly(belize_stn_map)
```

## 3.3 Save Plot

```{r}
stn_map_sv <- 
 here("data", "raw", "placencia", "fig", Sys.Date(),
  paste0("placencia_stn_map_rd", Sys.Date(), ".jpeg")
  ) %T>% 
  print()

if (FALSE) {
  
  dir_create(dirname(stn_map_sv))
  
  ggsave(
    filename = stn_map_sv,
    plot = belize_stn_map,
    device   = "jpeg",
    dpi      = 600,
    width    = 8.5,
    height   = 9,
    units    = "in",
    bg       = "white"
  )
  
} else {
  message("Not saving mangrove map with points!")
}


```


## 3.4 Belize Inset Map


```{r belize}
shelf(rnaturalearth, rnaturalearthdata)
belize_bounds <-
  tibble(
    lon = c(-89.5, -87.8), lat = c(15.8, 18.5)
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = wgs_crs) %>%
  # convert to projection in meters
  st_transform(crs = belize_epsg) %>%
  st_bbox()

# ---- Country polygons for the inset ---- #
countries <- 
  ne_countries(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf") %>%
  st_transform(crs = paste0("EPSG:", belize_epsg))

# --- inset plot ---- #
inset <-
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries, fill = "grey90", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2) +

  geom_sf(
    data = subset(countries, name == "Belize"),
    fill = "#435e7b", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
  # bounding box
  geom_sf(data = placencia_bbox, fill = NA, color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +

  # country labels
  geom_sf_text(
    data = country_labels, 
    aes(label = name, angle = angle),
    size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", 
    color = country_labels$color
    ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = belize_bounds[c(1,3)],
    ylim = belize_bounds[c(2,4)],
    expand = FALSE
    ) +
  ggmap::theme_inset() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "aliceblue", color = "black"),
    panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8)
  )
inset
```
